meta.rule: a tag is a contract: what cost it removes, and when it stops working

aes-ni.removes: hashing rounds on the critical path
aes-ni.fails_when: the CPU has no AES instructions, or the hasher must be portable

alloc-tracking.removes: allocation churn you cannot see in a CPU profile

arrangement-indexing.removes: recomputing a join arrangement on every change
arrangement-indexing.fails_when: the arrangement never changes, so the index is dead weight

async-native.fails_when: the work is CPU-bound and blocking

automata-compilation.fails_when: patterns need backreferences or lookaround, which DFAs cannot express

backend-trait.removes: one kernel per device written by hand
backend-trait.fails_when: a single backend is all that will ever ship

batching.removes: one syscall or round trip per item
batching.fails_when: latency per item matters more than throughput

bitmap-index.removes: per-id set operations in a hash table
bitmap-index.fails_when: density is very low, where the bitmap is mostly zeros

branchless.fails_when: the branch is predictable, where a branch is faster

broad-phase-narrow-phase.removes: pairwise collision checks on every object pair
broad-phase-narrow-phase.fails_when: object counts are small enough that pairwise is cheap

btf-probe.removes: a tracer tied to one kernel version
btf-probe.fails_when: BTF is unavailable, where the fallback must be maintained

bulk-loading.removes: incremental inserts during a one-shot build
bulk-loading.fails_when: the tree is mutated continuously after the load

c-binding.fails_when: a portable pure-Rust build is required

cache-conscious-layout.fails_when: the working set already fits in L1

classical-algorithms.fails_when: the algorithm is not the bottleneck

code-layout.removes: instruction cache misses from cold code in hot paths
code-layout.fails_when: the workload never reaches the reordered paths

columnar.removes: per-row deserialization and cache misses over wide rows
columnar.fails_when: the workload touches whole rows rather than a few columns

columnar-layout-optional.removes: forcing one memory order on every caller
columnar-layout-optional.fails_when: the caller cannot afford the copy a layout change requires

combinators.fails_when: the grammar needs error recovery a combinator cannot express

compact-index.removes: per-entry pointers in exchange for an index
compact-index.fails_when: entries are removed frequently, so the index must be repaired

compact-serialization.removes: loading the whole structure to answer one query
compact-serialization.fails_when: the structure is rebuilt often, where build time dominates

component-layer.fails_when: the app needs a bespoke interaction model

const-generics.removes: runtime dimension checks in numeric code
const-generics.fails_when: dimensions are dynamic and known only at run time

copy-on-write.removes: locking readers out during a write
copy-on-write.fails_when: writes are frequent and the copy dominates

cost-model-driven.removes: optimising the wrong term of the hardware bill
cost-model-driven.fails_when: the workload changes faster than the model can be maintained

data-parallel.removes: single-core wall time on separable work
data-parallel.fails_when: the work has a serial dependency or the data is too small to split

datalog.fails_when: queries are simple lookups, where a full engine is overhead

declarative-dsl.removes: imperative UI code that drifts from state
declarative-dsl.fails_when: the UI is trivial, where the DSL costs more than it saves

density-dependent.fails_when: density swings widely within one workload, so no single choice holds

dst-in-ci.removes: concurrency bugs that only appear under a rare interleaving

elm-architecture.fails_when: the app is a single screen with no shared state

embedded.removes: a server round trip for local queries
embedded.fails_when: the data does not fit on the device

embedded-first.removes: an app that cannot run without a browser stack
embedded-first.fails_when: the app needs a browser engine's rendering

epoch-reclamation.removes: blocking readers while memory is freed
epoch-reclamation.fails_when: the workload allocates rarely and never reads concurrently

extensible.removes: forking an engine to add one operator
extensible.fails_when: the extension surface becomes the maintenance burden

feature-gated-safety.removes: choosing safety or speed once for all users
feature-gated-safety.fails_when: the safe path is fast enough, where the flag is complexity

findings-as-verdicts.removes: raw counters that a human must interpret
findings-as-verdicts.fails_when: the hypothesis is still being formed and verdicts mislead

finite-fields.removes: generic arithmetic that misses field structure
finite-fields.fails_when: the field is not fixed at compile time

finite-state-transducer.removes: storing a set as sorted strings
finite-state-transducer.fails_when: the set is mutated often, where rebuild cost dominates

generic-graph.fails_when: the graph needs a representation the generic one cannot express

generic-vertices.fails_when: vertex ids must stay dense integers for speed

gpu-rendered-ui.removes: CPU work per frame in the UI layer
gpu-rendered-ui.fails_when: the UI is mostly text, where GPU setup dominates

hamt.fails_when: the map is mutated in place anyway

hit-ratio-first.fails_when: the working set is stable and eviction never runs

hnsw.removes: exact nearest-neighbour scans over the whole index
hnsw.fails_when: recall requirements are very high or the index does not fit in memory

hot-patch.removes: a full rebuild after a one-function edit
hot-patch.fails_when: the change touches layout or types the patch cannot express

hyaline-reclamation.removes: reader registration cost on every read
hyaline-reclamation.fails_when: the read path can afford a pointer bump

hybrid-cache.removes: re-reading from disk what RAM could hold
hybrid-cache.fails_when: the working set is far larger than any cache tier

immediate-mode.removes: retained widget trees and their bookkeeping
immediate-mode.fails_when: the UI needs fine-grained widget identity and focus

incremental-view-maintenance.removes: recomputing a whole view after each change
incremental-view-maintenance.fails_when: changes are rare, where the machinery costs more than the recompute

inline-storage.removes: a heap allocation for short vectors
inline-storage.fails_when: values routinely exceed the inline capacity

invariants-as-tests.removes: invariants that live in a document nobody runs
invariants-as-tests.fails_when: the invariant is too expensive to check per test

inverted-index.fails_when: the corpus is tiny, where a scan is cheaper

io-uring.removes: one syscall per operation and the thread-per-connection model
io-uring.fails_when: kernel older than 5.1, or the workload is not I/O bound

jit.removes: interpreting the same hot path repeatedly
jit.fails_when: the program runs once, where compilation never pays back

join-split.removes: idle cores while one task runs

kernel-fusion.fails_when: the passes cannot be fused without changing semantics

kernel-matrix-in-ci.fails_when: the matrix is too expensive to run per change

lock-free.removes: a global lock around every operation
lock-free.fails_when: contention is low, where a lock is simpler and faster

lock-free-parallel-walk.removes: a global lock around directory traversal
lock-free-parallel-walk.fails_when: the tree is small enough that the lock is never contended

lsm.removes: random writes into a B-tree's pages
lsm.fails_when: reads dominate and the compaction debt is never repaid

lsm-plus-btree.removes: picking one write path for every workload
lsm-plus-btree.fails_when: the workload is stable, where one structure is simpler

memory-bounded-streaming.removes: peak memory proportional to the artifact
memory-bounded-streaming.fails_when: the artifact fits in RAM, where streaming is pure overhead

merkle-tree.removes: rehashing a whole artifact to verify one chunk
merkle-tree.fails_when: the artifact is small, where the tree is overhead

miri-in-ci.removes: undefined behaviour the type system cannot see

multi-core-hash.fails_when: inputs are small, where the split costs more than it saves

no-python.removes: a Python dependency in the hot path
no-python.fails_when: the ecosystem only exists in Python

no-std-friendly.removes: a runtime dependency in embedded targets
no-std-friendly.fails_when: the target has an allocator and threads

object-storage.removes: a local disk tier that must be provisioned
object-storage.fails_when: latency per read matters more than durability

parallel-algos.fails_when: the graph is too small to split

partitioned.removes: one global index over all data
partitioned.fails_when: partitions are skewed, so one dominates

perf-integration.fails_when: the profiler cannot attach to the target

pgo.fails_when: the profile is unrepresentative, which makes layout worse

poseidon2-gf2.removes: slow field arithmetic in proof systems
poseidon2-gf2.fails_when: the field is not the bottleneck

prefilter.removes: a full regex engine run on every byte
prefilter.fails_when: the pattern has no literal to prefilter on

prefix-keys.removes: comparing whole keys at each node

proof-carrying-performance.removes: bugs that only appear under concurrency
proof-carrying-performance.fails_when: the design is still moving, so proofs cost more than they save

pure-rust-port.removes: a C dependency in the build
pure-rust-port.fails_when: the C library is far faster and portability is not a goal

python-bridge.fails_when: the caller cannot cross an FFI boundary

quality-vs-speed.removes: speed claims that ignore retrieval quality
quality-vs-speed.fails_when: quality is not a variable in the workload

quantization.removes: memory traffic per vector at query time
quantization.fails_when: the accuracy budget is tighter than the compression allows

query-optimization.fails_when: the plan is already optimal, where the optimiser is overhead

rank-select.fails_when: the structure is mutated, which rank/select resists

read-optimized.removes: write locks on a read-mostly map
read-optimized.fails_when: writes dominate, where read-optimisation costs more

recursive-proofs.removes: verifying every step on the verifier

relative-pointers.fails_when: the data must be mutated after load

runtime-dispatch.removes: a compile-time SIMD fork per target
runtime-dispatch.fails_when: only one target will ever run

sandboxing.fails_when: the sandbox cost exceeds the risk

sharding.removes: one lock over the whole map
sharding.fails_when: keys are skewed, so one shard dominates

shuttle-in-ci.removes: races that depend on an untested interleaving

simd.removes: per-element branching and scalar instruction count on hot loops
simd.fails_when: data is branchy, small, or already memory-bound

skills-in-repo.removes: an agent misapplying the tool from a stale man page
skills-in-repo.fails_when: the skill is not updated with the code it describes

statistical-rigor.removes: conclusions drawn from a single noisy run
statistical-rigor.fails_when: the effect size is far below the measurement noise

storage-backend-flag.removes: one storage backend for every deployment

stringview.removes: copying strings out of a buffer
stringview.fails_when: the buffer is mutated while views are live

structural-sharing.fails_when: the collection is mutated in place

succinct.removes: storing the data structure in expanded form
succinct.fails_when: queries need mutation, which a succinct form resists

table-driven.removes: recomputing per byte what a table could hold
table-driven.fails_when: memory is tighter than the instruction budget

tape-representation.removes: building an object tree while parsing
tape-representation.fails_when: the consumer needs owned values immediately

thread-per-core.removes: cross-thread scheduling and its coherence traffic
thread-per-core.fails_when: the load is uneven across cores

tls-13.removes: a handshake round trip before the first byte
tls-13.fails_when: the peer only speaks older TLS

typed-effects.fails_when: the app has no cross-layer state

typed-parse-direct.removes: parsing into a document, then into a struct

valgrind-based.fails_when: the code is I/O bound, where instruction counts mislead

vendor-pinning.removes: an unpinned dependency you did not audit
vendor-pinning.fails_when: upstream moves faster than the pin can be maintained

versioned-locks.removes: a write-lock increment on every read
versioned-locks.fails_when: the critical section is long, where retry costs more

verus-in-ci.removes: invariants that are only argued in prose

views.fails_when: the consumer mutates the underlying buffer

wakeup-contract.removes: hidden snoozing that turns into deadlocks
wakeup-contract.fails_when: the future never needs a wakeup

window-tinylfu.removes: scan-resistant thrash in a small cache
window-tinylfu.fails_when: the access pattern has no scan component

work-stealing.removes: idle cores while one queue is deep
work-stealing.fails_when: tasks are uneven in size and the scheduler thrashes

zero-copy.removes: copying bytes between buffers and the allocations that go with it
zero-copy.fails_when: the consumer needs to own or mutate the bytes

zero-macro-ergonomics.removes: macro-heavy APIs that cost compile time
zero-macro-ergonomics.fails_when: the API genuinely needs code generation
